title: Sample New Luxury Gift Box
seoTitle: Sample New Luxury Gift Box | Magnetic Rigid Box Supplier
metaDescription: Example R2 product JSON for a magnetic rigid box with foam insert, strategy, design, manufacturing and logistics support.
description: A sample product JSON showing how to publish a new product through Cloudflare R2 without committing a new HTML file to GitHub.
quickAnswer: For a new luxury gift box project, buyers should confirm product dimensions, box structure, insert type, printing finish, sampling needs and export logistics before requesting a factory quote.

specs.Box type: Magnetic rigid box / collapsible magnetic gift box
specs.Common materials: Greyboard, art paper, specialty paper, kraft paper
specs.Insert options: Foam insert, paperboard insert, EVA insert, molded pulp insert
specs.Finishing: Matte lamination, soft touch, hot foil, embossing, spot UV

procurementChecklist: Confirm product dimensions and target packaging structure.
Choose rigid box, drawer box, tube packaging or paper gift bag format.
Prepare logo, artwork, Pantone colors and finishing requirements.
Approve dieline, sample and pre-production proof before bulk manufacturing.
Confirm export carton, pallet, air freight or sea freight requirements.

faq.question: Can this product be added without rebuilding the whole website?
faq.answer: Yes. Upload this JSON to R2 under products/sample-new-luxury-gift-box.json, then call the revalidate API for /products/sample-new-luxury-gift-box.html.

faq.question: Will old product URLs change?
faq.answer: No. Existing static product URLs remain unchanged and continue to serve from the same paths.

faq.question: What is the best CTA for this page?
faq.answer: Ask buyers to send product size, order quantity, artwork and destination address for a factory quote.
